text: どうぐは　いつ　つかえば　いいの？

structure.jp: いつ　つかえば　いいの？

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.explanation: The ば form plus いい says 'it would be good if I did', which is how you say 'should'. いつ つかえば いい = 'when should I use them'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a casual sentence makes it a soft question asking for an explanation. いいの？ = 'is good, I wonder?'.
